column1: On your way back to the office, Keith says..."Man, that punk Bains is a slick rat, isn't he?"
column2: 回辦公室的路上，基斯說……「那個班恩斯真是隻狡猾的老鼠，對吧？」

column1: Keith sniffs the air and says... "Gracious me, buddy boy! You've got the car smelling like a rose garden."
column2: 基斯聞了聞空氣，說……「天啊，老兄！你把車裡弄得像玫瑰園一樣香。」

column1: Whatcha gonna do with that foilage? Keith asks.
column2: 「你打算拿那些花草怎麼辦？」基斯問道。

column1: Keith comments..."I thought you two were getting a little serious. I guess I was right."
column2: 基斯評論道……「我就覺得你們兩個有點認真了。看來我猜對了。」

column1: Boy! Keith says..."After yesterday, I was hoping for a slow day."
column2: 「天啊！」基斯說……「經過昨天，我本來希望今天能平靜一點。」

column1: I'll advise Dispatch, Keith says, grabbing the mike... "Dispatch...53Mary2... we're responding to 753 Third Street for follow up."
column2: 「我向派遣中心回報，」基斯拿起麥克風說……「派遣中心……53Mary2……我們正前往第三街 753 號進行後續調查。」

column1: Dispatch responds..."10-4... 53Mary2 rolling to 753 Third St for 187 follow up."
column2: 派遣中心回覆……「10-4……53Mary2 前往第三街 753 號進行 187 後續調查。」

column1: I think we may be getting somewhere, partner. Keith says.
column2: 「我想我們可能快有進展了，夥伴。」基斯說。

column1: We'd better watch our butts when we get there. Keith says.
column2: 「到那裡後我們最好小心點。」基斯說。

column1: Keith says..."I hope this lead isn't a dead end."
column2: 基斯說……「我希望這條線索不是死路。」

column1: Keith keys the mike and informs Dispatch of the bad news.
column2: 基斯按下麥克風，將壞消息通知派遣中心。

column1: Dispatch...53Mary2...We are 10-8 in route to office. Be advised we have found signs of struggle.
column2: 「派遣中心……53Mary2……我們 10-8，正在返回辦公室。請注意，我們發現了打鬥痕跡。」

column1: It appears the occupant of the house, one Marie Wilkans has been kidnapped. Please advise the Captain.
column2: 「看來屋主瑪麗．威爾肯斯遭到綁架。請通知警監。」

column1: 53Mary2..We copied the possible 207 kidnap, and will 10-5 the information to 53Mary1.
column2: 「53Mary2……收到疑似 207 綁架案，我們將以 10-5 把資訊轉達給 53Mary1。」

column1: Keith manages an encouraging smile. "We'll get her back, Sonny."
column2: 基斯勉強露出鼓勵的笑容。「我們會把她救回來，桑尼。」

column1: Dispatch...53Mary2...we are 10-6, enroute to airport.
column2: 「派遣中心……53Mary2……我們 10-6，正在前往機場。」

column1: 53Mary2 10-4. Copied 10-6 enroute to airport.
Well, ole buddy, ole pal! Keith says..." Here's hoping we make it back alive."
column2: 「好了，老夥伴、老朋友！」基斯說……「希望我們能活著回來。」

column1: I don't care what you say. Keith says..."I'm having another cigarette before I board that plane."
column2: 「不管你怎麼說。」基斯說……「登機前我要再抽一根菸。」

column1: Dispatch...53Mary2. Keith says.."We are 10-7 at the airport and will see you when we get home."
column2: 「派遣中心……53Mary2。」基斯說……「我們在機場 10-7，回家後再見。」

column1: You listen as the radio comes alive with your call number... "53mary2, Dispatch...we have further traffic for you."
column2: 你聽見無線電傳來你的呼號……「53mary2，這裡是派遣中心……有進一步通報給你。」

column1: Keith grabs the mike and answers... "Dispatch...53mary2. Go ahead with your traffic."
column2: 基斯拿起麥克風回答……「派遣中心……53mary2。請說明通報。」

column1: 53mary2, 10-4 dispatch continues..."Traffic Officer Haines has located a vehicle belonging to the correctional officer at Oak Tree Mall."
column2: 「53mary2，10-4，」派遣中心繼續說……「交通警員海恩斯在老橡樹購物中心找到一輛屬於矯正員警的車。」

column1: Continuing, "Per Captain Hall, respond to that 10-20 and 11-98 with Officer Haines...Dispatch clear."
column2: 接著說：「依霍爾警監指示，與海恩斯警員一同前往該 10-20，並進行 11-98……派遣中心完畢。」

column1: After acknowledging the radio call, Keith mumbles to Sonny..."Well, you heard it, big boy. Let's roll!"
column2: 確認無線電通話後，基斯對桑尼喃喃說……「好了，大個子，你都聽到了。出發！」
